verdict.rationale: Wise exposes statements in accounting-friendly formats (CSV, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, QIF) and offers webhooks and a card-transaction API, so transaction data can be fed into accounting software. There is no evidence of a native, automatic sync with any accounting package, so a finance lead would need file imports or a custom integration. Missing for 10: named native accounting-software integrations (e.g., Xero/QuickBooks), automatic ongoing sync of transactions and expenses, expense/receipt categorization sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.
